nodes.label: Navy rounded-square app icon with white winged P and light-blue stem tip
nodes.rationale: Rounded-square icon on a black outer canvas. The fill is flat deep navy. Centered is a white capital-P letterform with a soft drop shadow. The top bar continues left into two left-pointing feathers, the upper one longer than the lower. The bowl is a thick white loop on the right with a navy counter. The stem descends and curves slightly left; its lower tip is light sky blue, split from the white by a near-horizontal edge. No brand name, tagline, or other readable wordmark.
